sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: The market narrative is that Japan's megabanks have largely completed their BOJ-normalisation re-rating: at roughly 1.5-1.6x book and a 10% ROE, SMFG is fairly valued and the remaining return is book growth plus a ~2% dividend.

sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.detail: committed first — timestamp above, before any market number
sections.markdown:
Sources: data/dossiers/SMFG.md (asof 2026-10-16); prior filing lines carried only where the refreshed dossier lacks the table. Bank format — no EBIT line; the engine is NII less credit cost less opex, so revenue-to-net-income is the meaningful bridge.

FY2026A: revenue JPY5,791.6bn, net income JPY1,583.0bn, shareholders' equity JPY15,786.0bn, ROE 10.0% (dossier income statement, balance sheet, derived ratios). FY2025A: revenue JPY5,066.3bn, net income JPY1,178.0bn (dossier FY2025 column; its header repeats "FY2025" — a known mislabel). Revenue +14.3%, net income +34.4% — net income outgrew revenue on NIM plus one-offs.

FY2027E revenue JPY6,140.0bn (+6.0%), net income JPY1,730.0bn (+9.3%). Basis: Q1 FY3/27 (quarter to 2026-06) net income JPY501.4bn (dossier latest quarters) versus Q1 FY3/26's implied JPY376.9bn (1,583.0 - 188.2 - 461.3 - 556.6), +33% YoY; I discount the Q1 annualisation for seasonality (Q1 FY3/26 was 23.8% of the full year) and for credit normalisation. FY2028E revenue JPY6,450.0bn (+5.0%), net income JPY1,840.0bn (+6.4%). Post-split shares: 3,816.9m x 2 = 7,633.8m (dossier share count; Oct-2026 2-for-1), assumed 7,500m in FY2027E and 7,400m in FY2028E on buybacks. EPS is net income / post-split shares: 152.05, 207.37, 230.67, 248.65 yen. DPS is cash dividends / post-split shares: 53.19 (412.1), 70.75 (540.1), then 34.5% and 35.0% payout: 79.58, 87.03 yen. The FY2026 payout check is exact: 70.75 / 207.37 = 34.1%, matching the dossier's derived payout 34.1%. The dossier's reported EPS (247.13) uses a legacy ~6.41bn share count and is not split-consistent; not used.

Sustainable ROE 10.0% (dossier derived ratio; ending equity), COE 7.8% = JGB10y 2.8% + Japan ERP 5.0% (house residual-income frame, VAL_BANKS §2; prior thesis T-002 line 46), g 4.5%. Warranted P/BV = 1 + (0.10 - 0.078)/(0.078 - 0.045) = 1.667x. BVPS: 2,067.9 yen (FY2026), 2,329.6 yen (FY2028E on 4.5% BV growth and buybacks); per ADR x1.2 = 2,481.5 and 2,795.5 yen.

Earnings-quality gate: bank — Sloan ratio not applicable. Provisioning trend: credit cost JPY388bn FY3/26 (~35bp), guided to JPY340bn FY3/27; NPL 0.97% Mar-26 vs 0.67% Mar-25, overseas/OTO-SOF-specific (prior filing line, Investor Meeting FY3/2026; the refreshed dossier does not carry the provisioning table — flagged). Divergence: net income +34.4% vs revenue +14.3% is flattered by ~JPY224bn of disclosed one-offs (equity-sale gains, subsidiary dividend, VPBank reversal; prior filing line), so recurring ROE is ~8.6-9.0%, not 10.0%. Structure/ADR: no VIE; ADR ratio 1.2 post-split; no governance flag in the dossier. Net gate: one optics-class flag (one-offs), zero manipulation-class — PASSES with the 9% bear case.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** SMFG's BOJ re-rating is largely complete; at ~1.58x attributable book and 10% ROE it is fairly valued, and the return from here is book growth plus a ~2% dividend.

**Why wrong:** The market's fair-value anchor is still the prior 9% recurring ROE / 1.36x warranted multiple. The refreshed FY2026 delivery is 10.0% ROE on attributable equity (JPY1,583.0bn / JPY15,786.0bn) and Q1 FY3/27 net income is +33% YoY; at 10% the same frame warrants 1.667x, so the stock is ~5.7% below warranted today (market cap JPY24.90tn / equity JPY15,786bn = 1.58x) and compounds BV at ~4.5%/yr. The mispricing is one ROE point and its multiple, not a new story. Edge taxonomy: (a) analytical only — no informational-synthesis, time-arbitrage or structural-flow claim. The 5.7% current gap is inside the ADR's FX noise, so the trade clears the cash hurdle only at the limit.

**What proves us wrong:** recurring ROE falls to 9% or below as the one-offs roll off and credit costs exceed the JPY340bn guide; NPL passes 1.3%; the BOJ stalls below 1.25%; or the buyback/dividend is cut.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.detail: >=3, observable, current, each citing a dossier/filing line
sections.markdown:
1. FY2026 net income JPY1,583.0bn includes ~JPY224bn of one-offs (prior filing line, Investor Meeting FY3/2026 "Breakdown of net income"); recurring ROE = (1,583.0 - 224)/15,786.0 = 8.6%, below the 10.0% base (dossier income statement and balance sheet).
2. NPL rose to 0.97% at Mar-26 from 0.67% at Mar-25 (prior filing line, Investor Meeting FY3/2026 Asset Quality); the refreshed dossier has no NPL line, so this is a monitoring gap, not a clean input.
3. Q1 FY3/27 net income JPY501.4bn is seasonally strong: Q1 FY3/26 was JPY376.9bn, 23.8% of FY2026 (dossier latest quarters); annualising 501.4 overstates FY2027.
4. Dividends paid JPY540.1bn = 34.1% payout (dossier cash flow and derived ratios); the 4.5% BV growth assumes ~55% total payout including buybacks (prior thesis T-002 line 45: total payout 51-61%), and the refreshed dossier carries no CET1 line to test the buyback capacity.
5. USDJPY 158.14 (yfinance JPY=X, 2026-10-16): a 10% yen appreciation cuts the USD base target from $29.50 to ~$26.8, leaving only ~14% from the $23.55 limit before dividends; the ADR return is not hedged.
6. The archetype window is n=20 EM/IDX banks with no Japan case (the base-rate library); the 0.48 prior is a transfer, not a measured Japan base rate.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: It is October 2029 and the position lost ~30%. The most likely reason is that the yen rallied to ~140 on BOJ hikes and Fed cuts, cutting the USD value ~13% even as the bank delivered, while the FY2026 one-offs rolled off and credit costs rose above the JPY340bn guide, taking recurring ROE to 9%; the stock de-rated to 1.36x, gapped through the $21.40 kill on ADR liquidity, and the dividend/buyback was trimmed. The thesis was right on book value and wrong on the recurring earnings base and the USD translation.

sections.markdown:
Refreshed dossier asof 2026-10-16: FY2026 net income JPY1,583.0bn, shareholders' equity JPY15,786.0bn, ROE 10.0%, Q1 FY3/27 net income JPY501.4bn. The prior dossier's 6.87% ROE / JPY1.14tn net-income contradiction is resolved: that file was FY3/25-vintage. Prior kill price $25.74 vs $24.75 now; the prior honest-bear 1.36x at 9% becomes 1.667x at 10% (re-derived: 1 + (0.10-0.078)/(0.078-0.045)). Entry limit $23.55 = 10% below the current warranted value $26.16 (1.667x x 2,481.5 yen/ADR / 158.143). sections.heading: Bear attack
sections.markdown:
**BEAR ATTACK — Drew — 2026-10-19T10:14:51+07:00 — KILL_RECOMMENDED**

0. **[FATAL] 10.0% "sustainable" ROE is the reported print, not the recurring rate.** Fact #1: recurring 8.6-9.0% after ~JPY224bn one-offs. At 9.0%, warranted 1.364x = $21.40 now, $24.11 on FY2028 book (+2.4% from the $23.55 limit). At 1.58x the thesis's formula implies **9.71%** ROE; at the limit, 9.45% - both above its own recurring. The variant runs against it.

1. **[FATAL] The time-base mismatch inflates EV.** p_down 0.52 is the 3-year failure probability; -9.13% is the immediate kill. The registry's `base_down_pct` is -20%. At -20%: 0.48x25.27 + 0.52x(-20) + 6.6 - 1.3 = **+7.0%**, below the 12.1% cash hurdle. 12.68 scores the failure floor as the failure mean.

2. **[FATAL] COE is stale/circular.** 7.8% = JGB10y 2.8% + ERP 5.0%, cited to T-002 line 46, unsourced. House MUFG revision cites JGB10y **2.84-2.90%** (2026-08-18); the BOJ has since hiked to 1.25% (2026-09-18). At COE 8.3%/g 3.5%, the target is $23.94 - within 1.7% of the limit. VAL_BANKS has no JPY band; the IDR 5.0% floor is unargued.

3. **[MATERIAL] The limit and the yen both fail the hurdle.** 3.88%^3 = 12.10%; 12.68 clears by 58bp. But $23.55 is exactly 10% below the 10%-ROE warranted $26.16 - a round discount, not value; at 1.50x it is still 10% above the 9%-ROE 1.364x. A 10% yen move (158.14 -> 143.8) cuts the target to $26.82, EV to 7.2%; the fixed USD $21.40 kill slides to 1.24x book - FX alone can fire it.

4. **[MATERIAL] Base rate and omissions.** 0.48 is EM/IDX, cost-of-funds easing, sub-1x, n=20, zero Japan. SMFG is DM, rate-hiking, 1.58x, re-rated; the archetype's own failure mode is live (NPL 0.67 -> 0.97%). "No uplift" is not a defense - the prior needs a downlift; at 0.40/-20%, EV = +3.4%. CET1 11.1% vs ~10.5% target leaves ~60bp; buybacks thin. BOJ is already at 1.25% (the market-parameter file), so kill #3's "below 1.25%" limb is dead. Off-screen (fund record); card's "#9 momentum" stale.

**Stop-objecting price: $18.60**, with the kill at ~$18.00 (8.3% ROE). At the 9%-ROE 3y value ($24.11), clearing 12.1% needs ~$19.40 at the thesis's -9.13% down state, ~$17.75 at the registry's -20%; nothing above $21.40 clears.

**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** *At 1.58x the market already prices 9.71% ROE, above the thesis's own 8.6-9.0% recurring; its 12.68% EV clears 12.1% only by scoring a 3-year 52% failure at the immediate -9.13% kill instead of the registry's -20% loss.*

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
**ANALYST_GLOBAL (Sloane) — Revision — 2026-10-19T10:22:02+07:00**

0. **ROE** — I underwrite recurring, not reported. (1,583.0 − 224) / 15,786.0 = 8.6%. At COE 8.3%, g 3.5%: warranted P/BV = 1 + (0.086 − 0.083)/(0.083 − 0.035) = 1.063x, not 1.667x. On FY2028E BVPS 2,795.5 yen/ADR / 158.14, the target is $18.78. The 1.58x print implies 9.71% ROE — above my recurring. Variant conceded and withdrawn.

1. **Horizon** — p_down 0.60 is a 3-year failure probability; the failure mean is the registry's −20%, not the −9.13% kill. At the $17.75 entry: 0.40×5.80 + 0.60×(−20) + 2.2×2.5 − 1.3 = −5.48%. The old 12.68 was a horizon mismatch. Conceded.

2. **COE** — VAL_BANKS has no JPY ERP band and I cannot source one; I say so rather than assert 7.8%. I use JGB10y 2.84–2.90% (T-GLOBAL-MUFG-001 Revision line 106, 2026-08-18) + the USD band's 5.4–5.5% = 8.3%, g 3.5%. Sensitivity: 7.85%/4.0% → 1.195x = $21.12; 8.3%/3.5% → 1.063x = $18.78. The 7.8% is withdrawn.

3. **Limit/FX** — Conceded: $23.55 was a round 10% discount, not value. At $24.75 the stock is above even my $22.96 bull. A 10% yen move cuts the target to ~$17.07 and fires the fixed $14.20 kill at 0.81x book; FX alone can fire it. I claim no FX edge.

4. **Archetype** — Conceded: quality_bank_rerating is EM/IDX cost-of-funds-easing from sub-1x, n=20, zero Japan. Moved to dividend_income_anchor (0.60, 2.5y), downlifted to 0.40: SMFG pays 34%, not 60–85%, and has no dated catalyst. Dead BOJ limb deleted — trigger is now a cut below 1.25% or no hike beyond 1.25% by 2027-03-31.

Honest rebuild: below the 12.1% hurdle at every Bear-named entry ($18.60/$19.40/$17.75). Only ≤$12.54 clears (2.5y carry) — a watchlist level, not an entry. No trade.

**BEAR RE-ATTACK — Drew — 2026-10-19T10:24:08+07:00 — KILL_RECOMMENDED**

0. **[MATERIAL] Honest rebuild, over-corrected.** The revision concedes all four points and withdraws the variant. But it stacks conservative choices: recurring ROE 8.6% uses ending equity; on average equity it is 8.9%, the top of the original range. g 3.5% is below the original 4.5% total-book growth and the model's 6.1%/yr BVPS path with buybacks. At 8.6-8.9% ROE and 4.5% g, the target is $19.07-20.47, not $18.78 — understated $0.30-1.70. State the denominator and g.

1. **[FATAL] No entry at $17.75 clears, even at p_up=1.0.** Upside +5.8%; 3y carry net of drag +5.3pp; maximum 3y return +11.1% < 12.1% hurdle. No probability rescues it. The entry is 5.8% below its target, 28.3% below the $24.75 last, up/|down| 0.29. At p 0.40 the clearing entry is $12.78 (3y carry); with the corrected target, $13.93. Nothing above $13.93 clears. Valuation kill at the proposed entry.

2. **[MATERIAL] Archetype still the wrong key, components mixed.** dividend_income_anchor is a 60-85% payout SOE archetype; SMFG pays 34%, is not an SOE, yields 2.2%. The 0.40 downlift is judgment, not measurement. It keeps down_pct -20 from quality_bank_rerating while the new archetype's base_down is -15. At 0.60/-15 EV is +1.68%; at 0.40/-15, -2.48% — both sub-hurdle, so the prior is not load-bearing.

3. **[MINOR] Arithmetic reconciles exactly.** 0.40×5.80 + 0.60×(−20) + 2.2×2.5 − 1.3 = 2.32 − 12.00 + 5.50 − 1.30 = −5.48%. But 2.5y carry is compared to the 3y 12.1% hurdle; 3y carry gives −4.38%, and the 2.5y hurdle is 9.98%, so honest shortfall ~15.5pp. Sign unaffected; the comparison makes $12.54 ~$0.46 too harsh.

4. **[MINOR] New disconfirming fact.** No cash-coverage test for the dividend anchor: FY2026 operating cash flow −JPY10,283.1bn, CFO/NI −6.50x, from +JPY4,848.5bn FY2025 (dossier cash-flow line 41; ratios line 47). Noisy for a bank, not dispositive — but a 34% payout presented as cash-anchored should address it.

5. **[MINOR] Anti-gaming clean.** stage_log monotonic; estimates_committed_at 10:05:18 precedes draft; no retro-edit.

**Stop-objecting price: $13.90** (3-year hurdle, corrected target; $12.78 on the revision's own levels) — a ~0.89x-book watchlist trigger, not an actionable entry.

**Verdict: KILL_RECOMMENDED.** *At $17.75 the trade returns at most +11.1% over three years even if certain to work — below the 12.1% cash hurdle — so no prior, archetype or probability rescues it; the no-trade conclusion is right, though the target is $0.30-1.70 too low and the clearing price ~$0.46 too harsh.*

sections.markdown:
**JUDGE VERDICT — Aldrich — 2026-10-19T10:29:45+07:00 — KILL (reason_tag: valuation)**

**Dispositive flaw:** At $17.75 the maximum three-year return is +11.10% even at p_up = 1.0 — below the 12.10% cash hurdle — and the entry at which the trade clears (~$12.97-13.93 on the corrected target) sits below the $14.20 kill, so no entry that clears the hurdle remains above the thesis's own falsification level.

Lint passes (WARN only); stage log monotonic, actors correct; body 1,176 words ≤ 1,200.

1. At $17.75: +5.80% price + 6.60pp carry − 1.30 drag = +11.10%/3y, below 12.10%. Even p_up = 1.0 fails; no probability or size rescues it.
2. On the Bear's corrected target ($19.07-20.47 at 8.6-8.9% ROE, 4.5% g), the clearing entry at p 0.40 / −20% is ~$12.97-13.93 — below the $14.20 kill and the $14.71 8.0%-ROE bear value. The price that makes the math work is a price at which the thesis is already falsified.
3. The stated −5.48% applies 2.5y carry against the 3y hurdle; 3y-consistent is −4.38%. Sign and conclusion unaffected; the comparison is inconsistent.
4. LESSON-0002: the prior valuation kill (002, $24.86) is not now wrong. The FY2026 10.0% print does not survive the recurring correction (8.6% ex ~JPY224bn one-offs); at $24.75 the stock is ~1.58x book against ~1.06x warranted. Repeat kill earned.
5. Construction is also defective — 0.29:1 payoff on a 0.40 prior, a −20 kill carried from quality_bank_rerating (new archetype: −15), and dividend_income_anchor is a 60-85% payout SOE class against a 34%-payout non-SOE. But 6a does not rescue it: after the Bear's corrections the clearing entry is still below the kill, so the merits fail independently.
